# apple_in_app_purchases (Data Source)

Lists an app's in-app purchases.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_in_app_purchases" "consumables" {
  app_id = data.apple_app.example.id
  types  = ["CONSUMABLE"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

### Optional

- `product_ids` (Set of String) Only purchases with these product IDs.
- `types` (Set of String) Only purchases of these types. Values: `CONSUMABLE`, `NON_CONSUMABLE`, `NON_RENEWING_SUBSCRIPTION`.

### Read-Only

- `in_app_purchases` (Attributes List) The in-app purchases. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--in_app_purchases))

<a id="nestedatt--in_app_purchases"></a>
### Nested Schema for `in_app_purchases`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the purchase.
- `name` (String) Reference name.
- `product_id` (String) Product ID.
- `state` (String) State.
- `type` (String) Type.
